prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

I am building several systems for my company and I may need help to support my other two developers. I am hoping to develop a long term relationship. Prefer someone who is available some of the USA hours, between 9 am PST to 7 pm PST.

text:
Hi — I’m a passionate, hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building reliable web applications across the stack.

I’d be glad to help with the kinds of random tasks you described, especially where React, Node, SaaS products, and modules are involved. I work comfortably across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, and I’m used to jumping into existing systems to support other developers without slowing the team down. I also understand the value of having someone dependable for ongoing, ad hoc work rather than a one-off task.

One project that aligns closely with what you need was **Embedded customer analytics** for a B2B SaaS product. I built usage dashboards embedded directly into the product so each customer account could see its own metrics. The rollout reached **140 customer accounts**, and it was **delivered 3 weeks early**. That kind of work required careful coordination between React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, along with attention to user-facing details and product fit.

I’d be a strong fit if you’re looking for someone who can move quickly, communicate clearly, and plug into an existing team when needed. I’m comfortable working on full-stack features, improving UI and frontend behavior, handling backend logic, and supporting SaaS-related development tasks as they come up. I also appreciate long-term relationships, especially when there’s an opportunity to become a reliable part of the workflow for your company and your other developers.

Your note about availability during USA hours also works well for me, and I understand the importance of being reachable during the 9 am PST to 7 pm PST window when coordination is needed.

Would you like me to start by helping with the most urgent React or Node task currently on your list?
